title: Resolve identified full-suite blockers and prove final subscription payload delivery
body:
<!-- closer-core/v1 followup-of=stranske/Workflows#4548@4549 -->
<!-- closer-core/v1 chain-depth=2 route=followup -->
## Why
The remaining work spans an assertion defect, two unresolved runtime stalls, complete-suite execution, and live consumer delivery; it exceeds a single focused repair of the validation helper.
Source issue #4548; merged PR #4549 delivered: PR 4549 delivered dependency-based validation environment provisioning, contributor instructions, setup regressions, and replayable downstream observations. It established focused credential-test success and documented pre-existing full-gate blockers without falsely claiming successful consumer delivery.

## Scope
- Resolve the contract mismatch between scripts/langchain/issue_pr_context.py::_truncate_section and tests/scripts/test_issue_pr_context.py::test_truncation_helpers_handle_a_budget_smaller_than_the_heading; preserve meaningful small-budget coverage.
- Diagnose .github/scripts/__tests__/keepalive-loop.test.js::replayCompletion and its exit-zero quota productivity test; bound spawned Python execution and resolve the demonstrated stall without excluding tests.
- Diagnose tests/scripts/test_llm_client_shared.py::test_subscription_pipe_renders_each_execution_mode[codex-ainvoke] and scripts/langchain/_llm_client.py; correct the proven runtime or fixture cause without disabling the test.
- On an identified main descendant containing b21fae85fe4f79e72c4133c29a3814b9d5950c3a, run node --test .github/scripts/__tests__/*.test.js and python3 -m pytest -q tests/ in the supported environment; append complete logs, revision, interpreter, timings and exit codes to docs/evidence/issue-4369/2026-11-08-validation.md.
- Read (never dispatch) the next scheduled or automation-started .github/workflows/maint-68-sync-consumer-repos.yml run and the immediately following .github/workflows/maint-71-merge-sync-prs.yml run to obtain exact source/consumer SHA receipts for the final templates/consumer-repo/tools/subscription_llm.py payload in stranske/Portable-Alpha-Extension-Model; record discussion 4434491702 disposition and a fresh all-pages issue-4369 comment observation in docs/evidence/issue-4369/.

## Non-Goals
- Do not redo work that PR #4549 already delivered.

> **Owner instruction (2026-11-08):** do not run `gh workflow run`, `workflow_dispatch` or `repository_dispatch` against Maint 68, Maint 71 or Maint 82. On 2026-11-08 13:34Z a single-consumer `force=true` Maint 68 dispatch from this work created a one-repo candidate plan that stalled the template-sync candidate lane. Delivery receipts come only from runs the scheduler or the sync automation start; if no such run happens before this PR is otherwise done, record the receipt task as not yet observable.

- [ ] Resolve the contract mismatch between scripts/langchain/issue_pr_context.py::_truncate_section and tests/scripts/test_issue_pr_context.py::test_truncation_helpers_handle_a_budget_smaller_than_the_heading; preserve meaningful small-budget coverage.
- [ ] Diagnose .github/scripts/__tests__/keepalive-loop.test.js::replayCompletion and its exit-zero quota productivity test; bound spawned Python execution and resolve the demonstrated stall without excluding tests.
- [ ] Diagnose tests/scripts/test_llm_client_shared.py::test_subscription_pipe_renders_each_execution_mode[codex-ainvoke] and scripts/langchain/_llm_client.py; correct the proven runtime or fixture cause without disabling the test.
- [ ] On an identified main descendant containing b21fae85fe4f79e72c4133c29a3814b9d5950c3a, run node --test .github/scripts/__tests__/*.test.js and python3 -m pytest -q tests/ in the supported environment; append complete logs, revision, interpreter, timings and exit codes to docs/evidence/issue-4369/2026-11-08-validation.md.
- [ ] Read (never dispatch) the next scheduled or automation-started .github/workflows/maint-68-sync-consumer-repos.yml run and the immediately following .github/workflows/maint-71-merge-sync-prs.yml run to obtain exact source/consumer SHA receipts for the final templates/consumer-repo/tools/subscription_llm.py payload in stranske/Portable-Alpha-Extension-Model; record discussion 4434491702 disposition and a fresh all-pages issue-4369 comment observation in docs/evidence/issue-4369/.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] python3 -m pytest -q tests/scripts/test_issue_pr_context.py::test_truncation_helpers_handle_a_budget_smaller_than_the_heading exits zero.
- [ ] The named Node productivity test and Python codex-ainvoke test terminate successfully under explicit diagnostic bounds.
- [ ] node --test .github/scripts/__tests__/*.test.js and python3 -m pytest -q tests/ both exit zero on the recorded revision, with complete raw logs.
- [ ] Receipts bind Maint 68's frozen source to final merged payload bytes in an exact consumer revision, followed by Maint 71's applicable finding disposition excluding discussion 4434491702.
- [ ] A complete issue-comment observation records no scoped recurrence through an explicit UTC time.
